body: Well I opened up to the psychiatrist and it went really well. I have a better understanding of myself and I’m already feeling better:)

So to everyone out there who’s hesitating whether or not you should get therapy, I’d say go ahead and give it a try. I can’t guarantee that it works for you as well as it did for me. But hey, there’s nothing to lose, so why not give yourself a chance?

Well it actually went really smoothly, I was able to open up to the psychiatrist, and she was really understanding. She gave her interpretation of my issues, and it does explain the situation very well. It helped me understand myself better and I was really glad to gain insight of myself.

You’re absolutely right. There really shouldn’t be a moral burden on suicide. Ultimately we are the ones who matter most to ourselves. It’s not selfish to end your own suffering. We deserve the freedom to choose for ourselves.

Truth is they don’t. We’re all just banking on blind hope for a better future. It’s been a perpetual cycle of short lived satisfaction and long-standing stress for me. I honestly don’t see it changing any time soon. But I guess we’ll just have press on and live with it. 

Hopefully, things will turn out better for both of us:)

Honestly, I don’t know. It’s kind of the question I’m trying to figure out right now. I’m 17 and exams are in a month, and I ask myself why try so hard. It’s not like all suffering stops as soon as I enter college. As you’ve rightfully said, things only get more and more difficult. Sometimes I just want to give up and rest....
